source.attribution: Aggregated counts derived from RansomLook (ransomlook.io), CC BY 4.0. No victim details are included.

notes: Sample snapshot. Run scripts/fetch-ransomware-feed.py on a host with API access to replace it.
Counts are aggregated per group. Victim names, post links, crypto addresses, and peer addresses are excluded.
Not live attack telemetry. This is a periodic snapshot of publicly reported ransomware posts.
